reviews.text: I called to speak with someone at the clinic, but the  call center representative was very rude. I put in a request for someone to call me back, but no one did. Fortunately, the staff at the clinic were very friendly, professional, informative. As far as I can tell the Vet performed his neutering surgery well. However, an ear mite removal was supposed to be done, but it never was. No pain medication  was given to administer at home. The cat was in a tremendous amount of pain. I called to inform the clinic the very next day and spoke with someone at the clinic. Last but not least I have volunteered at many animal shelters/clinics from Las Vegas to Houston and I am appalled at the whole situation, because I have never  witnessed any thing of this nature.

By appointment is recommended, not low cost. You have to pay $65 just to be allowed in the room prior to vaccinations. The vaccines are cheaper at the Harris County Pet clinic. No extra fees there and their phone etiquette is better as well.
I am so grateful to the TLC team for all of their help with a dog I found and am currently fostering. They also spayed a feral I had trapped. Their kindness and generosity mean so much!

I had such a great experience with Texas Litter Control! Everyone was so kind, patient, and professional, and I could tell they genuinely cared about Twinkle and her well-being. They made me feel comfortable throughout the entire process and answered my questions, which meant a lot because I was nervous about her surgery.

Twinkle’s spay went smoothly, and I’m so grateful for the care she received. The staff was amazing from start to finish, and I truly appreciate the work they do to make affordable veterinary care available to families and their pets.

Thank you, Texas Litter Control, for taking such good care of my baby girl! 🥹💕 I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and affordable place to take their pets.

We have been in multiple times now between checkups and her spay. Everyone here is amazing and wonderfully kind. The prices are the best in the area, especially if you pay cash, and they're very patient answering all my questions to keep my little void safe and happy and healthy. We love Texas Litter Control!!!

I would recommend it a thousand times over if I could. I appreciate their kindness, attention, and patience. Everyone there is very professional and, above all, kind. I had four of my cats operated on there, and I can only express my gratitude for the wonderful treatment I received and, especially, their professionalism.

I miss Greater Good. Bring them back!!!

I went to Greater Good for 13 years, and they were consistently affordable, efficient, and transparent. Their staff provided amazing, fast service with no hidden fees or unnecessary charges. I'd pull up, tell them what I need for my dog. I could usually get my dog in and out in about 30 minutes.

Unfortunately, Texas Litter doesn't compare. If you're a new client, they charge a $40 clinic visit fee on top of the cost of the vaccines. Returning clients still have to pay a $20 clinic fee.
At those prices, I'd rather order what I need from Chewy and just take my dog to my regular vet for vaccines.

Not to mention this place is clearly leaching off the positive reviews from when Greater Good was here. Sleazy! Just like how they charge you. You should earn your own reputation and reviews instead of relying on the goodwill built by someone else.

I really wish Greater Good was still around. These chain clinics just aren't it.

New name and owner is NOT the same as Greater Good. Totally different vibe. I checked the website before going in and didn’t see a lot of info about the changes. You must have an appointment or be charged a walk-in fee. If you continue here, you’ll be charged a yearly vet fee and then vaccinations can be discussed. I’ll stick with my normal vet from now on.
Great staff and easy communication!!! They answer you quickly and always professional. The animals are well cared for and surgeries are done with care!!!!
Good place to get medicine or a check up for your pet
Awesome experience and awesome staffs!
they are very nice and knowledgeable here. i took the community cat here to get spayed and they were great

I used to really like this place because it was actually affordable you only paid for the vaccinations. Since the new company took over, they now charge an office visit fee on top of the vaccines, even though the appointment was basically just getting the shot. I mentioned that I used to come to the old clinic, but nobody explained there was now a mandatory vet fee beforehand. I only realized it after I was already in the room looking at the pricing myself. At that point, I could honestly just go to my regular vet clinic. Hopefully they’re helping pet owners in other ways, but it no longer feels like a low-cost clinic to me. I will be finding a new place now unfortunately.
They're really good for having your puppy sprayed &also give a comforting medicine to help them stay comfortable doing their process of healing.

This place is a problem, it says it closes at 7 but at 6 they don’t attend anymore! I arrived at 6 and they said no! I made an appointment two days later but I was 10 minutes late because of the traffic because I’ve been on my way for 45 minutes. And when the doctor arrives without having anyone, she didn’t want to attend, please have more empathy. The boy is very decent and very attentive. But don’t waste your time
Fabulous job with spaying cats!

I’ve had an extremely pleasant experience with the vets and staff at the greater good Texas litter control. It’s nice to be able to have access to quality veterinary care at affordable pricing. We brought my daughter’s kitten in for his vaccinations as well as a neuter. The whole process has been very easy to navigate and the entire staff has been so kind and helpful. I recommend any pet owner that needs a neuter/spay and vaccinations to the GREATER GOOD ! Thanks you
Very kind attendant and dr.  a little wait, then we got a quick appointment.

2 stars because the staff was extremely nice and professional.

Misleading website and frustrating experience. The way services for Texas Litter are described makes it unclear that vaccinations are considered part of a wellness visit. The page title separates “Wellness and Vaccinations,” but then only states that wellness services require an office visit fee.

I came in for a vaccine only and did not need a full exam or any medications, so there was no reason for me to expect an office visit charge.

I specifically chose to go to Greater Good because my cat is very reactive and can only tolerate handling for a short period of time. While the Texas Litter staff and vet were kind and tried their best, they were unable to successfully administer the vaccine.

Overall, the lack of clear communication and transparency led to unnecessary stress for my pet and unexpected costs. I won’t be returning.

Update:
Texas Litter has responded to me, rectifying the situation if I decide to visit them again. They stated that everyone knows what they do since they have been operating since 2013. However, the website now clearly states "wellness/vaccinations" since, obviously, not everyone knows what they do.
Disappointed. Used to take all my pets to the Greater good, but they are not there anymore. Took my cats to their annual shots. Instead of usual $50 paid $140. Have to find another place.

Took my litter for first shots prices were reasonable.
Now that Texas Litter  has taken over Greater Good its no longer affordable. They are now charging $40 for Vet exam before you can get the vacine you need. 40 plus vacine. Not affordable.
My dog was neutered here and the process was very fast( drop in the morning-picking between 5-6 pm). The staff is professional and the pricing is quite reasonable. Highly recommend
They have great prices and positive attitudes
They are very good and the prices are excellent.
They met me at the door got right in $150 Dewormed, Rabies, other shots, I forgot, Going back to get her neutered.
I love the Greater Good. They are so nice to all of our forever friends!
In and out for adorable rabies shot

I came today to get my three dogs vaccinated for the first time. I came at a great time as there was not really others there present. As soon as I pulled up, Ms. Victoria came out with such a friendly demeanor and assisted my pups and I. Ms. Victoria is extremely efficient, kind, and professional. Ms. Mary Pat is like an angel offering to hold and spoil my dogs, as well as helping other customers after my arrival. They are a breath of fresh air. Ms. Laura (I did not really interact with) helped with heart-worm testing for my dogs. It is evident she is a great team player and assisted other customers promptly. Great service, low cost vaccinations, and low wait times. It’ll be great to see other places institute such great service at such great value. Much thanks to Dr. Kuehl for helping to bring along these excellent ladies and offering this type of service!

This office is heaven sent and their staff are literal angels!!

I recently rescued a tiny kitten who was lying in the middle of the road and about to get ran over by oncoming traffic. While I was determined to help her, I quickly realized how overwhelming it can be. I called multiple organizations and “rescues” that constantly ask for donations and claim to help animals in need, but every single one told me they were full and couldn’t assist. Even refused to take her because she's too young (4-5 weeks old), despite me informing them about my lack of confidence in care and a cat allergy. It was very disheartening and frustrating because when you’re in the moment of need, those promises often feel empty.
But then I found this veterinary clinic, and it was truly a blessing. From the very first call, the staff treated me with kindness, patience, and compassion. I’ve never owned a cat before (and honestly, I’ve always been a little afraid of them), so I needed guidance with everything... feeding, litter training, basic care. The team here went above and beyond to educate me, answer every question, and reassure me every step of the way. They didn’t make me feel silly or inexperienced; instead, they empowered me to care for this little life I rescued.
And the prices? Absolutely, genuinely affordable. I’ve seen so many clinics advertise “affordable” care, only to charge the same as everywhere else. This clinic is different. Their pricing truly reflects their mission, and they absolutely live up to their name... The Greater Good.
I am so grateful for the angels who work here! Because of them, I walked out with confidence and hope. I cannot recommend them enough!!

P.S. If you're looking for a business/organization to donate to with assurance your donations will really be put to tangible use that can be trusted, I personally RECOMMEND donating to this clinic (and no they didn't ask me to say this...this is just straight from my heart and personal experience)!!

Super fast, efficient, kind staff! And you cannot beat the prices for their vaccines and services! My kitten has gotten all her boosters here and they even removed the pressure wraps from her legs for me after we had visited the vet. This will be my go to for both my cats’ vaccines moving forward! Be prepared to bring cash! They do not take credit cards!
Good place to take your cats and dogs to neuter and to vaccinate. Caring staff.
They come to you , so you stay in the car, the vaccinations are a reasonable price better than the vets

Fast, friendly and affordable.
Thank you for great service!!!
Best care for cats and dogs. Great prices
Staff is great, always great customer service, and efficient! I had two dogs that they take great care of and the services are affordable!

Whoever I spoke to over the phone the second time was extremely rude. Said there was a cancellation and I told her my cat is currently sick, knowing they won't take sick/injuried animals. Told her my cat was puking and had diarrhea. That's all the info she got and very rudely says "If it last longer than 3 days that can cause kidney failure" said I understand and she repeated herself two times after. Will NOT be cing if that's how they speak to people over the phone. Can't imagine what it would be like on person
Efficient and friendly curbside service.
Quick and the best prices!
What a wonderful place - Dr. Kuehl and his staff are so professional and compassionate. So affordable - please consider donations of materials listed on their website.
Went there for the first time and we will absolutely go back for our dog’s vaccinations. You don’t have to get out of your car, they do everything very efficiently and fast.
Very professional staff, the best one !
Easy and affordable place to get pet vaccinations.

I took my puppy there for spay. Few days after the spayed my dog still would not eat. I called the emergency number they provided. Also after one month the incision started to look red and i thought it was infected. Both incident i got the return call the same day. They also provided me with free antibiotik. I very recommended this clinic. Thank you

I called a month and a half in advance, as recommended on their website, to schedule my pup for surgery in January. They contacted me a week before the appointment on January 25 to confirm, and I did. However, just a couple of days before the surgery, they called again to inform me that the appointment had been canceled. They explained that Dr. Kuehl was experiencing health issues.

I requested to stay on the schedule for February, and they initially agreed. But a few days later, they called back to inform me that my pup would be removed from the schedule, as Dr. Kuehl was unlikely to continue performing surgeries.

Although they provided information about a couple other offices, we were disappointed that after waiting a month and a half, the appointment was canceled at the last minute. When I first scheduled, they mentioned that my pup, being a bit older (he’s is four), would require additional monitoring during anesthesia, which would come with an extra fee. Part of me wonders if that may have been the real reason for the cancellation.
Such an amazing cause. Sending my thoughts and prayers. God bless you all and the amazing work that you do.
Quick experience. Low cost per vaccines for cats and dogs. Friendly staff. I haven't used them for any other service on my cat.

Just got my 2 babies fixed today! Mary Pat was so INCREDIBLY helpful in getting them scheduled & was able to get us right in after they had a cancellation!! I’m so thankful for what they do in helping to control the pet population by offering affordable services!! Highly recommend!!
Staff is very friendly and service is quick

Haven’t gone yet , but I’ve been searching for an affordable place to take my puppy for her first rabies vaccine. I called and left a msg today with a question about the service. (They are closed for the holidays.) I received a call back shortly after and the lady was so polite and informative, I definitely will be choosing them for my vaccination location when they open next weekend. Even though they’re closed, she is checking the messages and responds quickly. Great customer service!! Thank you.
Friendly and helpful staff. Quick and efficient!
Gogi fries are the bomb
I just got my cat neutered and they did a fantastic job. The surgeon is really good and my cat barely bleeder after the surgery. He’s already acting normal now. I really recommend this place.

Good luck getting your pet in here. My husband has called multiple times and left voicemails to get our furbaby Ruxin scheduled for neutering… They’ve only called us back once from an UNKNOWN number on caller ID (of course we thought it was spam and didn’t answer) and immediately called back and no answer of course! If you are desperate to bend over backwards to get an appointment scheduled, then this is your place.

I had a great experience at this clinic. The lady running the place was incredibly kind and patient, taking the time to thoroughly explain the entire process and post-surgery care. The surgery went smoothly, and the wound was well attended to afterward. I’m really glad I found this place for my cat's surgery, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality care.
Fast service, great pricing, friendly and no pressure to do more than necessary.
